verdict.rationale: Maritime is a cloud platform for hosting AI agents and provides metered LLM access, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no policy, setting or guarantee about whether customer data is used for model training. Encrypted secret variables and scoped API keys are adjacent security controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
